meta.description: Machine-readable ledger tracking the migration of every production-reachable COBOL / embedded-SQL / embedded-CICS semantic type onto the unified declarative-manifest + recursive-ST4 assembler. BMS is tracked only as BMS_ARTIFACT (a separate CICS screen-map DSL), never as a COBOL dialect. FPac and other non-COBOL pipelines are out of scope.

ratchet.note: Debt counts may only move down for the COBOL scope. Refresh per phase.

cloudNativeGate.note: Full :naca-cloud-native:test is 39 tests / 1 documented pre-existing failure (== discoveredDebt PREEXISTING-WSMESSAGE). The migration gate is the focused LedgerConsistencyTest only. Do not require the whole module green.

onlineCorpusInventory.note: Phase 3: inventory is now STATEMENT-ACCURATE (per source line+dialect+command, classified exactly once as PRESERVED / REJECTED / SILENT_DROP), no package-aggregate counting. DiagnosticSink (diagnostic.DiagnosticSink) collects structured diagnostics non-aborting so a whole program is inventoried per statement; throws when no sink is open (fail-closed gate). EXEC SQL INCLUDE counts as PRESERVED when it resolves/inlines (CJavaInline at the statement line).

targetArchitecture.migrationPlaybook: 6 steps: (1) semantic entity read-only getters + de-abstract; (2) one semantic-*-bindings.properties line; (3) one java.stg template reading only entity.* properties; (4) feature-registry.yaml entry (+ runtime-operations.yaml/template-runtime-requirements.yaml if new runtime ops); (5) CJavaEntityFactoryST.NewEntity* override; (6) delete legacy direct backend + render test + ratchet bumps. READ domain (semantic.Verbs.CEntityReadFile -> recursiveReadFileEntity) is the exemplar.

scheduler.note: Fields consumed by the external loop in tools/st4-loop (run-loop.sh). Per-entry: priority (lower=first), dependencies (ids that must be >= production-wired), verification (deterministic commands), expectedDebtDelta, attempts, blocked, blockedReason, lastAttemptCommit. The loop selects exactly one highest-priority READY item: scope in COBOL_CORE/EMBEDDED_SQL/EMBEDDED_CICS (never BMS_ARTIFACT / FPac), productionReachable, not terminal (status direct-retired or done — debt already removed, never re-selected), not blocked, all dependencies satisfied. BMS/FPac are out of the migration queue and tracked only as separate debt.
scheduler.workerDefaults: permission-mode=acceptEdits (configurable via --permission-mode among acceptEdits/auto/plan/manual; bypassPermissions/dontAsk/dangerously-skip are refused), worker-timeout=1800s (configurable via --worker-timeout), prompt piped via stdin, git-mutation deny rules always applied. Claude API/quota errors pause the run without consuming ledger attempts or marking the semantic slice blocked.

discoveredDebt.returnAt247-root-cause: RETURN@127 is bare (preserved); RETURN@247 has TRANSID('TRA1') COMMAREA(ONLINEFS). VERIFIED: DoParsing (CExecCICSReturn.java:105-165) parses the TRANSID(...)/COMMAREA(...) form fine — the parser element IS created with transID+commArea, so parsing is exonerated. DoCustomSemanticAnalysis adds the node at CExecCICSReturn.java:54 (parent.AddChild, line=247) BEFORE the transID block (lines 56-97); only ONE CJavaCICSReturn node exists in the whole tree (at 127), so the 247 node is discarded AFTER AddChild. GetProgramForTransaction returns '' (no throw) and CheckProgramReference returns boolean, so the throw is in the transID/commArea data-reference resolution (transID.GetDataEntity / commArea.GetDataReference / RegisterReadingAction, lines 62-95) propagating up and discarding the partially-built statement. FIX DIRECTION: trace the semantic-analysis exception handler that drops a verb child on exception, and make the TRANSID/COMMAREA lowering degrade gracefully (a missing transaction/program must not throw away the RETURN node). Then RETURN@247 becomes PRESERVED; verify with the statement-accurate inventory.
